S.FORM: ni-kuli-sivatə cakəranə sua vərəŋa, i-vatu sua canumu tatia.
S.PHON: nikuɾiʂivatə ʦakəranə sua vərəŋa ivatu sua ʦanumu tatia
S.FORM: nikurisivate cakerane sua verenga, ivatu sua canumu tatia.
S.PHON: niku[r|ɾ]iʂivate ʦake[r|ɾ]ane sua ve[r|ɾ]eŋa ivatu sua ʦanumu tatia
S.TRANSL: An eel blocked the river sideways, so there was a big flood.
They worried about not having fire.
It was not afraid of water.
It went to Nauserana to bring fire.
A wild pig came to eat the eel.
The wild pig said, "Give me food!"
It was given things, all things (to eat).
"From now on, have pity on me and make me eat what you planted."
